decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA total income $98,651 and pay stub ~$102,620 annualized are below the stated $106,000 (about 3-7% shortfall), so materiality needs escalation.
Chequing balance of $141,376 with over 3 months of history and no large or unusual deposits covers the $106,200 down payment plus closing costs.
Appraisal from approved panel firm Rive-Nord Evaluations supports value ($426,000 vs $425,000), but it is dated 2026-02-20, about 4 months before review, and policy does not define recent.
GDS is about 33.5-36.1% and TDS about 37.4-40.0% (50% vs 100% condo fees), within limits, with credit score 765 (DTI-02).
